attouche2026.citation: Lyes Attouche, Mohamed-Amine Baazizi, Dario Colazzo, Giorgio Ghelli, Carlo Sartiani and Stefanie Scherzinger. Witness Generation for Classical JSON Schema. ACM Transactions on Database Systems 51(4), 2026.

baazizi2026.citation: Mohamed-Amine Baazizi, Nour El Houda Ben Ali, Dario Colazzo, Giorgio Ghelli, Stefan Klessinger, Carlo Sartiani and Stefanie Scherzinger. JSON Schema Inclusion through Refutational Normalization: Reconciling Efficiency and Completeness. arXiv:2603.25306, 2026.

wolflein2026.citation: Georg Wölflein. subsumes-benchmark: a benchmark corpus for JSON Schema inclusion checking. 2026.

rb-testset.description: The pairs of the replication package of the jsonsubschema tool, with schemas from Kubernetes, Snowplow and the Washington Post.

mergeallof.description: Schemas against the output of a rewriter that merges their allOf, built from the unit tests of json-schema-merge-allof.

schemastore-versions.description: Successive versions of real schemas from SchemaStore.

oneof-as-anyof.description: Real schemas against themselves with oneOf replaced by anyOf: is oneOf used where anyOf would be equivalent?

additional-as-uneval.description: Real schemas against themselves with additionalProperties and items rewritten through unevaluatedProperties and unevaluatedItems.

uneval-as-additional.description: Schemas using unevaluatedProperties or unevaluatedItems against a translation to additionalProperties and items.

json-schema-test-suite.description: Pairs built from the test cases of the official JSON Schema Test Suite for draft 2020-12: each schema against its instances, its negation and itself.

scaling-families.description: Six families of generated cases that grow with a size, each member with a twin whose answer flips, to show where a checker stops or goes wrong as the cases grow.
